features: Display: UltraGear 27 in (68.4 cm), VA panel (2560 x 1440), 16:9 aspect ratio, With brightness levels of 300cd/m2 (typical), a contrast ratio 3000:1, wide 178o(R/L), 178o(U/D) viewing angles, making it suitable for both work and entertainment.

180Hz Refresh Rate & 1ms Response: With a 180Hz refresh rate and a 1ms response time, the monitor delivers smooth, fluid visuals, Fast-paced content such as gaming or video playback remains responsive and free from distracting motion blur.

HDR10 & HDR Effect: HDR10 support for enhanced contrast and brightness, HDR Effect mode for vivid, lifelike visuals, The anti-glare surface ensures comfortable viewing in different lighting conditions.

Professional Color Accuracy: sRGB 99% (CIE1931) Color Gamut, 8bit (6bit+FRC) Color, 16.7M Color Depth, Multiple picture modes including Custom, Gamer 1, Gamer 2, FPS, RTS, Vivid, Reader, HDR Effect, Color Weakness.

Eye-Care Features: To reduce eye strain during long sessions, the monitor integrates Flicker Safe, Reader Mode, Color Weakness, these features make extended use more comfortable and healthier for the eyes.

Gaming Enhancements: Gamers benefit from AMD FreeSync, which eliminates screen tearing, Black Stabilizer, and Dynamic Action Sync further enhance gameplay by improving clarity, responsiveness, and visibility in dark scenes.
Versatile Connectivity: The monitor offers flexible connections with HDMI 2 (HDCP 2.2, VRR 48~144Hz ), and a 3-pole headphone out, This makes it easy to connect PCs, consoles, and audio devices.

Smart Convenience: Convenience is built in with Auto Input Switch, which automatically detects active connections, OnScreen Control software, available in 17 languages, allows easy customization of settings

Design & Ergonomics: 3-side virtually borderless design that maximizes screen space, It also supports tilt adjustment from -5° to 20°, ensuring comfortable viewing angles for productivity and entertainment
Energy Efficient : 22W ERP typical power consumption, <0.5W sleep mode, <0.3W DC off.
